rules: This workspace belongs to one agent role. Read index.md for its scope, exclusions and channels.
Keep work documents and progress in the responsible group ADK under docs/work/.
Store shared memory in memory/common and group-specific memory in memory/groups/<group>. Keep each group’s data, channels, keys and memory separate.
List group IDs under agent_config.groups in adk.json. Do not link group directories into this workspace.
Link project ADKs through relative projects/<id> symlinks and list each ID under agent_config.projects.
Keep secrets out of repositories, instructions and records. Receive keys through the environment at session startup.
When multiple sessions share a working directory, use read-only access until instructed.
Use only this role’s bot for greetings and replies.
Obtain human approval for production changes, payments and external sends.

Before starting work assigned on a messenger, reply to the original in the requester’s language, mention them, and state the task and an ETA. Report the result in the same thread and keep unfinished work open.
